newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian journalist freed pending appeal.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian journalist freed pending appeal.

text.p: A Tanzanian journalist was freed on Thursday pending his appeal against a one-year jail sentence for breaching national security laws, court officials said on Friday.
Adam Mwaibabile was released on bail and Judge Dan Mapigano said he agreed with defence lawyers that the appeal to be heard on April 18 had every chance of succeeding, they added.
The freelance journalist, based in the southern region of Songea, was jailed late last month for a year for possessing what was said to be a secret official document. He was arrested last April.

The Tanzania Association of Journalists and Media Workers said the document was a letter intercepted by Mwaibabile from a regional commissioner to the Songea town director, telling him to deny the journalist a licence to operate a stationery shop.
